speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling on your palms. To narrow this down, does this rash appear in specific patterns like on the sides of your fingers or between them?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is a significant exposure history. Regarding your palm symptoms, is this numbness and tingling present bilaterally (in both hands) and has it been worsening over the same year-long period?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's Disease). The combination of hypopigmented macules, loss of eyebrows and eyelashes, and symmetric numbness/tingling of the palms in a farmer with livestock exposure is highly specific. Given the chronic nature and distinct signs, no further diagnostic tests or questions are required.
